content: better-sqlite3 13.0.3 vs node:sqlite (Sept 2026): node:sqlite still emits ExperimentalWarning on Node 22 LTS; reached Stability 1.2 (release candidate) only in Node 25.7+. better-sqlite3 v13 now ships prebuildify binaries (prebuilds/ dir, 8 platforms) - verified 2s install with NO node-gyp compile, so the classic native-build objection is gone. engines node>=22. Pick better-sqlite3 for a long-lived daemon; node:sqlite only if zero-dependency matters more than stability.
